# Test ACME authority

An instance standing for the **organisation's DNS and certificate authority**, a shared service of the internal services plane, for the tests of the tenants' certificates ([ADR-0008](../../../docs/adr/0008-tenant-certificates.md)):

- **Knot**, authoritative for the test zone, accepts RFC 2136 updates signed with **one TSIG key per tenant**; each key may change only the TXT records `_acme-challenge.<name>` of its tenant's names.
- **step-ca** serves an ACME directory and validates DNS-01 challenges against Knot. Certificates are valid 90 days, like Let's Encrypt's.

Its `certificates` output is, per tenant, the `certificates` input of the tenant stacks. The root certificate is generated by this stack: its key is in the state and, with the TSIG keys, in the instance's user data, readable by the members of the project. **For tests only**, in a project of its own.

Nothing is exposed on the Internet: DNS (53) and ACME (443) answer the internal services plane only. It gets its packages through `egress_network` and is administered through a bastion, like the stacks. Create it **after** `stacks/shared/planes` and **before** the tenant stacks, which need its `certificates` output.

```bash
cat > terraform.tfvars <<'VARS'   # git-ignored
cloud = "..."; site = "site-a"; az = "..."; image = "..."; flavor = "..."; boot_volume_size = 8; network_mtu = 1362
egress_network = { network = "...", subnet = "..." }
bastion        = { external_network = { network = "...", subnet = "..." }, ssh_cidrs = ["192.0.2.10/32"] }
users          = { debug = ["ssh-ed25519 AAAA..."] }
zone           = "example.org"
tenants = {
  web      = ["site-a.example.org", "site-b.example.org"]
  platform = ["apps.platform.example.org"]
}
VARS
tofu -chdir=../../../stacks/shared/planes output -json attachments | jq '{plane_attachment: .acme.planes}' > planes.auto.tfvars.json
tofu init && tofu apply
tofu output -json certificates | jq '{certificates: .web}' > ../../../stacks/tenants/vm/certificates.auto.tfvars.json
```

### Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| ---- | ----------- | ---- | ------- | :------: |
| az | n/a | `string` | n/a | yes |
| bastion | Administration bastion: floating IP on external\_network, SSH from ssh\_cidrs. | <pre>object({<br/>    external_network = object({ network = string, subnet = string })<br/>    ssh_cidrs        = list(string)<br/>  })</pre> | n/a | yes |
| cloud | n/a | `string` | n/a | yes |
| egress\_network | External network giving the default route (package download). | `object({ network = string, subnet = string })` | n/a | yes |
| flavor | n/a | `string` | n/a | yes |
| image | n/a | `string` | n/a | yes |
| plane\_attachment | The service's entry of the attachments output of stack shared/planes (role shared on internal). | <pre>map(object({<br/>    mode         = string<br/>    nat          = bool<br/>    cidr         = string<br/>    network_id   = string<br/>    network_name = string<br/>    subnet_id    = string<br/>    routes       = optional(list(object({ destination = string, next_hop = string })), [])<br/>  }))</pre> | n/a | yes |
| site | n/a | `string` | n/a | yes |
| tenants | The tenants that obtain certificates, keyed by tenant name, with the names (domains) each may<br/>get a certificate for. Each tenant gets its own TSIG key, allowed to update only the TXT<br/>records \_acme-challenge.<name> of its names. | `map(list(string))` | n/a | yes |
| users | SSH users (login => public keys, sudo granted), on the bastion and the authority. | `map(list(string))` | n/a | yes |
| boot\_volume\_size | n/a | `number` | `null` | no |
| cidr | Range of the authority's network; on a hub plane, the attachment's cidr in shared/planes. | `string` | `"10.37.0.0/28"` | no |
| dns\_nameservers | n/a | `list(string)` | `[]` | no |
| network\_mtu | n/a | `number` | `null` | no |
| step\_version | Versions of step-ca and step-cli (Debian packages of the smallstep releases), pinned. | `object({ ca = string, cli = string })` | <pre>{<br/>  "ca": "0.30.2",<br/>  "cli": "0.31.0"<br/>}</pre> | no |
| zone | The test zone served by Knot; the tenants' names are under it. | `string` | `"example.org"` | no |

### Outputs

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| address | Address of the authority on the internal services plane (DNS on 53, ACME on 443). |
| bastion | Floating IP of the bastion on the administration network. |
| certificates | The certificates input of each tenant stack, keyed by tenant: ACME directory, root, DNS-01 through RFC 2136 with the tenant's TSIG key. |
| instance\_address | Address of the authority on its own network, reached through the bastion (SSH). |
| root\_certificate | Root certificate of the test authority, for the clients of the tests. |
| tenants | Names each tenant may obtain certificates for. |
| zone | The test zone. |
